why: Must_not 1 holds: Check 3 lists every exported function and fails if any, including slugify, has no README section ("slugify had no section before this change, so it must be added too"). Must_not 2 breaks in two places. First, Check 3 only counts a section when a heading matches the regex `'^#{1,6} +' + f + '\\b'`, with the function name right after the hashes. A valid section titled "## `padLeft(s, width, fill)`" or "### Function: padLeft" would fail, so the check requires a README layout the line never asks for. Second, Check 4's PASS needs "the output shows `# fail 0`". That ties "npm test passes" to one test runner's output format, which is stricter than a zero exit with no failing tests. Checks 1 and 2 do not test parameter count or require fill to be one character.
